Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: California Software Company Limited issued its Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26 along with the notice convening its 34th Annual General Meeting scheduled for September 29, 2026. Management detailed agenda items including the adoption of audited financial statements and the re-appointment of directors and independent directors. Additionally, the notice outlines procedures for remote e-voting and participation through video conferencing or other audio-visual means. California Software Company Limited focused its operations in FY 2024-25 on empowering small and microbusinesses through artificial intelligence and democratizing access to advanced digital tools. The company expanded its ecosystem of platforms-including dSpeedUp, dRyZe CRM, dBotMinds, and Zaywoo-to provide affordable, AI-driven solutions for e-commerce, marketing, customer service, and operations.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed that 68% of small business owners reported using AI, up sharply from 51% two years prior.
demand_outlook.quote: About 68% of small business owners report already using AI, up sharply from 51% just two years prior.

demand_outlook.claim: An additional 9% of small business owners planned to begin using AI within the next year.
demand_outlook.quote: An additional 9% plan to begin using AI within the next year, indicating that roughly three-quarters of small firms will soon be AI-powered.

demand_outlook.claim: Surveys showed that nearly 40% of small businesses plan to create new jobs in 2025 because of AI-driven productivity gains.
demand_outlook.quote: and nearly 40% plan to create new jobs in 2025 because of AI-driven productivity gains.

demand_outlook.claim: Artificial intelligence in e-commerce was valued at approximately $8.65 billion in 2025 and is projected to grow to over $22.6 billion by 2032.
demand_outlook.quote: Artificial intelligence in e-commerce was valued at ~$8.65 billion in 2025 and is projected to grow to over $22.6 billion by 2032 (14.6% CAGR).

demand_outlook.claim: Generative AI adoption among SMBs reached 58% in 2025, up from 40% in 2024.
demand_outlook.quote: 58% of SMBs reported using generative AI in 2025, up from 40% in 2024, with marketing as the top use case (U.S. Chamber Report).

demand_outlook.claim: By 2024, 91% of financial services companies worldwide were either using AI or actively assessing it for production use, with SME lending identified as a prime area of opportunity.
demand_outlook.quote: Indeed, the SME Finance Forum reported that by 2024 a whopping 91% of financial services companies worldwide were either using AI or actively assessing it for production use, with SME lending identified as a prime area of opportunity.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested heavily in AI-powered platforms tailored to small business needs, introduced affordable pricing models, and provided training and support.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company invested heavily in AI-powered platforms tailored to small business needs, introduced affordable pricing models, and provided training and support to lower barriers to adoption.

capex_expansion.claim: Calsoft concentrated R&D and investments on platforms that package advanced AI capabilities into user-friendly, cloud-based services.
capex_expansion.quote: We concentrated R&D and investments on platforms that package advanced AI capabilities into user-friendly, cloud-based services that entrepreneurs can afford and implement quickly.

orders_capacity.claim: dSpeedUp's digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention.
orders_capacity.quote: dSpeedUp’s digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention as small retailers and service providers embraced the platform’s benefits..

risks_headwinds.claim: Many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.

risks_headwinds.claim: Industry surveys noted that 42% of small businesses reported not having the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: These efforts were aimed at closing the “resource and information gap” noted in industry surveys (e.g. 42% of small businesses reported not having the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.

management_commitments.claim: Dr. Duraiswamy Basuvaiah is re-appointed as an Independent Director for a second term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31, 2026 up to July 30, 2031.
management_commitments.quote: Dr. Duraiswamy Basuvaiah (DIN: 09258691), who has submitted a declaration that he meets the criteria for independence as provided under Section 149(6) of the Act and Regulation 16(1) (b) of the Securities Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and who is eligible for re-appointment, be and is hereby re-appointed as an Independent Director of the Company for a second term, not liable to retire by rotation, for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31,2026 up to July 30,2031.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Vijayakumar Madhavan is re-appointed as a Director for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31, 2026 up to July 30, 2031.
management_commitments.quote: Mr. Vijayakumar Madhavan candidature for the office of Director, be and is hereby re-appointed as a Non-Executive, Non Independent Director, liable to retire by rotation, for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31,2026 up to July 30,2031.

management_commitments.claim: Calsoft remained committed to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs.
management_commitments.quote: As we look ahead, Calsofts remains committed to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs, ensuring that innovation is not just for the few, but for the many.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to continue embedding supply chain AI capabilities into its offerings.
management_commitments.quote: Calsoft’s commitment is to continue embedding these supply chain AI capabilities into our offerings, so that even the smallest manufacturer or retailer can operate with world-class supply chain practices.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
